headline: Executive order by President Clinton about the Organization for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons, the global body that oversees the chemical weapons ban.
what_it_does: Only the title of this 1997 order is available, so its exact terms cannot be confirmed here. Orders with titles like this one usually name an international organization as eligible for certain legal protections and privileges in the United States under the International Organizations Immunities Act. The Organization for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons carries out the international treaty that bans chemical weapons.

who_it_affects.group: The Organization for the Prohibition of Chemical Weapons and its staff
who_it_affects.how: If the order follows the usual pattern, the organization and its officials would get certain legal privileges and immunities when operating in the United States.
